verdict.rationale: Airbyte's typing-and-deduping feature documents exactly this story: one-to-one stream-to-table mapping ('No more sub-tables'), typed destination schemas, and dedup handling, combined with CDC support for capturing deletes/updates and schema-change management for evolving sources. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that destination tables are fully typed and deduped in practice (only vendor docs cited), and no evidence addressing edge cases like large-table or complex nested JSON typing fidelity.
